agent_reports.text:
Base-case DCF on a 10-year explicit forecast: revenue CAGR 7.1%, terminal FCF margin 27.5%,
WACC 8.4%, terminal growth 2.5%. Fair value per share $291.00 against a $210.35 market price,
an implied upside of 38.3%. Bear case (WACC 9.6%, terminal growth 1.5%) yields $232.00;
bull case (services mix +300bps) yields $348.00. Sensitivity is dominated by the terminal
FCF margin: each 100bps moves fair value roughly $13.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.50

Trailing 12-month realised volatility 22.4%, beta 1.14 against SPX. Net cash position of
$51.0B and interest coverage above 40x remove balance-sheet risk from the tail. Largest
identified tail is single-country manufacturing concentration; a 20% China production
disruption maps to roughly a 9% EPS hit. Max drawdown over the last five years 31.4%.
Downside scenario at the 5th percentile implies $172. Risk-adjusted, the position sizes
comfortably at full weight.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.40

Revenue +9.6% YoY with services +14.2%. Operating margin expanded 140bps YoY to 31.8%.
OCF/NI of 1.12 and 1.08 in the trailing two quarters indicates clean cash conversion with no
accrual build. Consensus EPS for the next four quarters has been revised +4.1% over three
months. Two consecutive quarters of positive earnings surprise (+3.8%, +5.2%).
No one-time items material to the quarter.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.90

Moat rating: WIDE. Switching costs across a 2.2B active device base, ecosystem lock-in via
services attach, and demonstrated pricing power (ASPs +6% into a flat unit market). Porter
assessment: supplier power low, buyer power low, substitution moderate, new entrants low.
Share in premium smartphones stable at roughly 55% over three years. Primary erosion risk is
regulatory unbundling of default-search economics.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.80

Price is 8.2% above the 200-day SMA with OBV making higher highs alongside price, the
validated alpha signal in this pipeline. RSI(14) 61.3, below overbought. Bollinger position
0.72. 14-day ATR $4.80. Nearest resistance $245.00, nearest support $198.50. Trend regime
classified as up with rising participation; no mean-reversion signal is active.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.80

10Y-2Y spread has normalised to +18bps from inversion, fed funds futures price two cuts
over the next 12 months, and IG credit spreads are at 92bps versus a 130bps five-year
median. Large-cap technology is a primary beneficiary of falling real rates given duration
in cash flows. CPI trending to 2.4%. Regime classified as supportive.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.50

DCF fair value $77.50 versus $62.40 spot, implied upside 24.2%. WACC 6.9% reflecting the
low beta, terminal growth 2.2%, terminal FCF margin 24%. The valuation gap is material but
highly sensitive to the terminal assumption; a 50bps cut to terminal growth removes roughly
a third of it.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.50

Leverage is the binding constraint: net debt/EBITDA 3.1x against a 2.4x peer median, with
$4.2B of maturities inside 18 months into a higher refinancing rate. FX translation exposure
is roughly 60% of revenue and the dollar has strengthened 6% on a trade-weighted basis.
Ongoing US tax litigation carries a $6.0B contingent exposure. Downside scenario $51.00.

SIGNAL_SCORE: -0.60

Organic revenue +3.1% but almost entirely price/mix; volumes were flat to -1%. Operating
margin +20bps. OCF/NI 0.94 and 0.91 in the trailing two quarters, a mild accrual build worth
monitoring. Consensus EPS revisions +0.4% over three months, effectively flat.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.20

Moat rating: WIDE but static. Distribution scale and brand remain intact; share is stable
rather than growing. GLP-1 adoption is a genuine long-duration volume headwind for sparkling
beverages, partially offset by the still portfolio. Pricing power demonstrated but nearing
the elasticity limit in developed markets.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.30

Price is 2.1% below the 200-day SMA and OBV is diverging negatively from price over 60 days.
RSI(14) 43.8. Bollinger position 0.31. 14-day ATR $1.05. Trend regime classified as down with
declining participation. Nearest support $59.80, resistance $65.10.

SIGNAL_SCORE: -0.40

Staples are a late-cycle defensive with a neutral setup here: falling real rates help the
bond-proxy characteristics, while a soft-landing rotation into cyclicals works against
relative performance. Dollar strength is a direct translation drag. Regime classified as
neutral.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.00

DCF fair value $16.90 against $21.80 spot, an implied downside of 22.5%. Foundry capex of
$25B annually keeps free cash flow negative through the explicit forecast; the model only
turns FCF-positive in year five under the base case. WACC 10.2% reflecting execution risk.

SIGNAL_SCORE: -0.50

Realised volatility 41.2% with beta 1.38. Net debt/EBITDA 4.6x and rising as EBITDA
compresses. Dividend was cut 66%, removing a support bid. Foundry ramp is a binary execution
risk: a further 18-nm-equivalent node slip pushes breakeven past the current cash runway.
5th-percentile downside $12.40. Max drawdown 62%.

SIGNAL_SCORE: -0.70

Revenue -8.4% YoY, fifth consecutive quarter of decline. Gross margin contracted 620bps to
38.2%. OCF/NI 0.61 and 0.58 in the trailing two quarters, a significant accrual build.
Inventory days rose from 118 to 141 against falling revenue. Consensus EPS revised -18.3%
over three months. Two consecutive negative surprises.

SIGNAL_SCORE: -0.60

Moat rating: ERODING. Server CPU share has fallen from 92% to roughly 76% over three years
against AMD, with ARM-based hyperscaler silicon taking incremental sockets. Process
leadership was lost and has not been regained. Pricing power is negative; ASPs are declining
into a mix shift. Foundry has no external anchor customer at volume.

SIGNAL_SCORE: -0.30

Price is 14.6% below the 200-day SMA. OBV is making lower lows confirming distribution.
RSI(14) 34.1 and not yet oversold enough to signal reversal. Bollinger position 0.18.
14-day ATR $0.95. Trend regime down with elevated participation. Nearest resistance $24.60,
support $19.20.

SIGNAL_SCORE: -0.50

Semiconductor capex cycle is past peak on the analogue and industrial end markets, though AI
accelerator demand remains a separate and stronger cycle that this issuer does not
participate in meaningfully. Export controls are a persistent revenue headwind. Regime
classified as mildly adverse for this sub-sector.

SIGNAL_SCORE: -0.20

DCF fair value $623.00 against $415.20 spot, implied upside 50.0%. Azure growth of 31% and
operating leverage on the AI capex cycle drive the gap. WACC 8.0%, terminal growth 3.0%,
terminal FCF margin 34%. Even the bear case at 9.5% WACC yields $498.00.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 1.00

Realised volatility 19.8%, beta 0.91. Net cash $34B, AAA-equivalent credit. Concentration
risk is limited; no customer exceeds 2% of revenue. The identified tail is AI capex
over-build, modelled at a 12% EPS impact in the adverse case. 5th-percentile downside $348.
Risk profile supports full sizing.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.80

Revenue +16.4% YoY, Azure +31%. Operating margin +210bps to 44.6%. OCF/NI 1.18 and 1.15 in
the trailing two quarters. Consensus EPS revised +6.8% over three months. Four consecutive
positive surprises averaging +4.4%. Commercial bookings +22% with RPO of $269B providing
forward visibility.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 1.00

Moat rating: WIDE and widening. Enterprise switching costs across identity, productivity and
cloud are compounding; the OpenAI relationship is a durable distribution advantage in
enterprise AI. Azure share has risen from 21% to 25% over three years against AWS. Pricing
power demonstrated through per-seat Copilot attach at $30 with no measurable churn.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 1.00

Price is 6.4% above the 200-day SMA with OBV confirming. RSI(14) 58.2. Bollinger position
0.66. 14-day ATR $9.10. Trend regime up. Nearest resistance $448.00, support $392.00.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.90

Regime is hostile. The 10Y-2Y curve has re-inverted to -42bps, real 10-year yields are at
2.4% and rising, IG credit spreads have widened 45bps in six weeks, and the Fed has removed
all cuts from the 12-month path after a 3.6% core CPI print. Long-duration equity is the
worst-positioned factor in this configuration regardless of issuer quality. Regime
classified as strongly adverse.

SIGNAL_SCORE: -1.00

DCF fair value $114.00 versus $88.15 spot, implied upside 29.3%. Margin expansion from the
advertising and marketplace mix carries the model; WACC 7.2%, terminal growth 2.8%.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.50

Realised volatility 17.1%, beta 0.62. Net debt/EBITDA 1.6x with laddered maturities.
Principal risk is gross-margin sensitivity to grocery deflation; 100bps of price investment
maps to roughly 4% of EPS. 5th-percentile downside $74.00.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.30

Revenue +5.8% YoY with US comps +4.6% and eCommerce +22%. Operating margin +35bps.
Advertising revenue +26% is the mix driver. OCF/NI 1.06 and 1.09 trailing. Consensus EPS
revised +3.2% over three months.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.70

Moat rating: WIDE. Scale in procurement plus a store network that doubles as fulfilment
infrastructure is not replicable at the required density. Share gains are coming from
higher-income households, which is the durable version of the trade-down narrative.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.50

Price is 11.3% above the 200-day SMA, OBV confirming. RSI(14) 64.8, approaching but not at
overbought. Bollinger position 0.78. 14-day ATR $1.60. Trend regime up. Resistance $93.20,
support $83.40.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.40

DCF fair value $28.90 against $25.60, implied upside 12.9%. The model is dominated by the
2028 LOE cliff; roughly 38% of current revenue faces exclusivity loss inside four years and
the pipeline replacement rate is the swing input. WACC 7.8%.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.20

Patent cliff concentration is the dominant risk: three assets representing 38% of revenue
lose exclusivity by 2028. Net debt/EBITDA 3.4x following the Seagen acquisition. COVID
franchise revenue has declined 71% from peak and the run-rate is still unstable, which makes
forward estimates unusually wide. Dividend coverage is adequate at 1.4x FCF but not
comfortable. No terminal signal score is supplied for this report.

Revenue -2.1% YoY excluding the COVID franchise, which remains a large negative swing factor
on a reported basis. Operating margin -80bps. OCF/NI 0.88 trailing. Cost realignment programme
targets $4B of savings by 2026 with $1.5B realised.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.10

Moat rating: NARROW. Patent-protected franchises confer real but time-limited pricing power,
and the oncology position acquired with Seagen is credible without yet being category-leading.
IRA price negotiation applies to two products from 2026. Competitive standing is stable in
the near term and structurally uncertain beyond the cliff. No terminal signal score is
supplied for this report.

Price is 4.2% below the 200-day SMA with OBV flat to slightly negative. RSI(14) 46.2.
Bollinger position 0.38. 14-day ATR $0.55. Trend regime classified as range-bound.
Resistance $27.40, support $24.10.

SIGNAL_SCORE: -0.20

Large-cap pharma is macro-insensitive relative to the index; the binding variable is US drug
pricing policy rather than the rate path. Regime classified as neutral.

SIGNAL_SCORE: 0.00
